english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for achieving an aim or goal.
This is the all-purpose choice for an achieved success; use 勝利 when victory in a conflict is explicit.
Use this for a successful outcome or accomplishment rather than a victory itself.

examples.english: I finally achieved success in this exam.
examples.traditional: 呢次考試我終於成功喇。

examples.english: After all that hard work, it was finally a triumph.
examples.traditional: 我捱咗咁耐，終於成功喇。

examples.english: This project was a success; it was a real win for us.
